props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: root_path
props.meaning: Where the tree starts. `/Project/70` scopes it to that project.

props.name: entity_types
props.meaning: Types a search may end on.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: Field holding the thumbnail URL. A row with no picture falls back to its type glyph.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: The muted line under the label. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.meaning: The muted line of your own. Wins over `subLabelField`.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: The right-aligned value, drawn by its data type.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: Right-aligned text of your own. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Shows the row's `code` beside the label when the two differ.

props.name: fields
props.meaning: Extra fields to request, so your own sub-label or secondary can read them.

props.name: no_match_label
props.meaning: Shown when a query matches nothing.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Row text, leading slot and glyphs.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when a level holds nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

events.name: selected
events.when: A row was picked. The second argument is every row its path runs through, root first.

keyboard.does: Opens the level below the row.
Moves the highlight, through a load-more page.
Picks the row, or opens it when it is not a searchable type.
